scientific_integrity: All claimed all-length statements have a run-decomposition and generating-function proof; finite checks are corroboration, not a replacement. No independent audit or human verification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Binary linear words, complete noiseless multiplicity-preserving length-two substring multispectra and fixed finite run caps only.
Not a claim of positive coding rate, noisy-read error correction, or uniqueness of every unconstrained admissible sequence.
Previously unindexed run-constrained Markov-type results could cover a portion of the conclusion.
title: Exact bigram-spectrum reconstruction under a bounded-run constraint
